description: Runs SeeGeo's full audit of a domain — crawler access for 16 AI bots, technical basics, structured data, content extractability, off-site presence, entity clarity — and returns the grade (A–F), category scores and the findings with fixes. Takes 20–40 seconds; waits by default. If the wait runs out the result says so — call get_audit with the id. Re-auditing the same domain within ten minutes returns the earlier result.

domain.description: A public hostname or URL, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com/pricing (the host is used).

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait before returning the in-progress audit (default 50, inside most clients' 60-second tool timeout; raise it if your client allows longer calls). If it runs out, call get_audit with the returned id.

wait.description: Wait for the audit to finish (default). If false, returns the id to poll with get_audit.

name: audit_site
title: Audit a website for AI visibility
